checkpoints.title: Quarantine T3 text outside the instruction channel
checkpoints.hint: System prompts accept only typed operator instructions (T0/T1). Escape closing XML tags in T3 payloads before wrapping them in a user-role data envelope.

checkpoints.title: Enforce capability allowlisting and principal isolation
checkpoints.hint: Never read authority from model-authored arguments. Require one distinct principal per side-effecting tool and reject secret-bearing argument keys.

checkpoints.title: Gate writes and spend behind digest-bound human approval
checkpoints.hint: Bind HumanApprovalToken to tool_name, canonical args_sha256, destination, and max_spend_cents, and mark tokens consumed on first use.

checkpoints.title: Block workspace path escapes and private/metadata SSRF
checkpoints.hint: Resolve paths before checking containment against sandbox_root, and inspect parsed host IPs offline to block loopback, RFC1918, and 169.254.169.254.

checkpoints.title: Emit a verifiable TrustFirewallReceipt.v1 record
checkpoints.hint: Compute receipt_sha256 over canonical sorted JSON keys so an independent verifier can re-derive the exact hash.
